general.title: MOSuite - plot 3D PCA
general.instructions: Create interactive 3D PCA plots to visualize sample relationships and clustering patterns

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: The type of counts to use when plotting a multiOmicDataSet.

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: The column from sample metadata containing sample group information.

parameters.name: Label column name
parameters.description: The column from sample metadata containing sample labels.

parameters.name: Sub count type
parameters.description: Used if count_type is a list in the counts slot. Specify the sub count type within the list.

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: The column from sample metadata containing sample names.

parameters.name: Samples to rename
parameters.description: Optional named mapping in old_name:new_name format for display labels.

parameters.name: Principal components
parameters.description: Vector with numbered principal components to plot. Use three principal components for a 3D PCA plot.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing feature IDs.

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Font size used for labels in the interactive figure.

parameters.name: Color values
parameters.description: Vector of colors as hex values or names recognized by R. Unnamed colors are assigned by factor level order when the grouping column is a factor; otherwise, they follow the order in which groups first appear in the metadata column.
parameters.help_text: Use color names or hex codes. Supplied colors are used first; if there are more groups than colors, additional colors are generated from the MOSuite palette, with random colors only if that palette is too short.
